description: Compress files and/or folders on a specific instance (by id or exact name) into a single archive. All paths must be in the same folder, and the archive is written into that same folder. Only .zip and .tar.zstd are supported; a name with any other extension gets .tzst appended. Nothing is deleted, so this needs no confirmation, but it can take a while for large folders.

archive_name.description: Name for the archive, e.g. "world-backup.zip". Only .zip and .tar.zstd (.tzst/.tar.zst/.tar.zstd/.zst) are supported; anything else gets .tzst appended.

instance.description: Instance id (preferred) or exact instance name.

paths.description: Files and/or folders to include, from the instance root. Every path must share the same parent folder.

name: compress_paths
title: Compress Paths Into an Archive
